summary.description: One plain sentence: what the agent did that frustrated these users, covering every high cause, or that no cause is proven.

checklist.description: One entry per check id in dossier/checklist.md, your own call on each measurement.

check.description: The check id, exactly as it appears in dossier/checklist.md.

question.description: The check as a plain question, e.g. 'Are the frustrated sessions about one topic?'

detail.description: One plain sentence answering the question.

causes.description: What the agent did wrong, one entry per group, high first, then most sessions. Empty when no cause is found.

title.description: One plain sentence, at most 15 words, naming what the agent did.

confidence.description: high = proven: the sessions show it and, with a repo, a located line produces it. medium / low = a lead.

what_changed.description: 1-2 plain sentences: the agent's behaviour, not the user's words.

how_it_caused_this.description: 1-2 plain sentences linking that behaviour to the users' frustration.

next_step.description: high: what to fix. medium / low: what would confirm it.

evidence_session_ids.description: Session ids from this finding's witness refs. At least one; unknown ids are dropped.

evidence_trace_ids.description: The flagged turns' trace ids from this finding's witness refs.

affected_count.description: How many of the frustrated sessions show it.

detailed_report.description: The full investigation as markdown. All evidence goes here. Must end with an '## Evidence audit' section, a table mapping every load-bearing claim to its evidence (a session id, a trace id, a repo path/commit, or a query), and a '## What would settle it' section.
